title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 19 in A major

character.text: Free verset or partimento-type fugue; a double fugue with a second subject from bar 23

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes. Returns in Link (bar 43).
sections.leads: From A major to E major

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: the opening of the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From E major to A major; perfect cadence in A major at bar 9

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A major (Soprano); Subject in D major, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 3) in part, in the same voices, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: the opening of the subject (2 times). Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint. Returns in Link (bar 22).
sections.leads: From D major to F♯ minor

sections.label: Subject in F♯ minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 3) in part, with the alto's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to E major; perfect cadence in B minor at bar 16

sections.label: Answer in E major, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 3) in part, with the alto's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a fourth every bar.
sections.leads: From E major to A major; perfect cadence in E major at bar 20

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A major (Soprano); Subject in F♯ minor, rhythm varied (Alto)
Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 10–13) in part, with soprano and alto exchanged, transposed. Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes. Returns in Episode 5 (bars 24–25). Returns in Episode 6 (bars 28–31).
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to A major

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 22) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals. Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From A major to F♯ minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in F♯ minor, rhythm varied (Alto); Subject in A major, rhythm varied (Soprano); Subject in D major, rhythm varied (Bass)
Link
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From D major to E major

sections.label: Subject in E major, rhythm varied (Alto)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 22) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the alto's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From E major to D major

sections.label: Subject in D major, rhythm varied (Alto)
Link
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 3) in part, in the same voices, a step lower. Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From D major to B minor; perfect cadence in D major at bar 33

sections.label: Subject in A major, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 7
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 3) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, a fourth lower. Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From A major to E major; perfect cadence in B minor at bar 36

sections.label: Episode 8
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From E major to F♯ minor

sections.label: Subject in F♯ minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 9
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 3) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to A major; perfect cadence in F♯ minor at bar 42

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A major, rhythm varied (Bass); Subject in F♯ minor, rhythm varied (Soprano); Subject in A major, rhythm varied (Alto)
Link
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 5) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the bass's line in the soprano, transposed. Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From A major to E major

sections.label: Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in A major at bar 49; perfect cadence in A major at bar 54

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 10–13). Returns in Episode 3 (bars 14–16). Returns in Episode 4 (bars 17–20). Returns in Link (bar 32). Returns in Episode 7 (bars 35–37). Returns in Episode 9 (bars 40–42).

sequences.text: a sequence falling by a fourth every bar
